title: Resolve home and absolute globs on the executing machine
when: An unquoted filesystem glob is checked before a zsh command.
need: Matching ~/Downloads/Meeting* and absolute globs pass after home expansion. Relative globs use the command working directory, and a plain cd earlier in the same command moves that directory. A glob containing $ or a backtick, or any glob after cd -, cd $target, or cd `cmd`, is allowed. Missing literal globs name the checked pattern and offer rg --files or a quoted tool pattern. Repaired commands leave shell redirections unquoted.
surface: Client-local and core unmatched-glob refusals share path resolution and repair helpers.
review: Source regression cases cover matching and missing home, absolute and relative globs in both hook paths, including a literal tilde directory and a home containing spaces. They also cover a cd that moves the checked tree, unexpanded $ and backtick globs, an unreadable cd, and redirections left unquoted in the repair. Live installed delivery remains unverified.
